notes.homogeneous_carrier: The S8 seam 'Point4' homogeneous point is spelled with the landed truck homogeneous carrier Vector4 (BSplineCurve/BSplineSurface<Vector4>); no new carrier was introduced.
notes.polyline_sample_count: CHORD_STATION_SAMPLES = 64 per section (named const in construct/loft.rs).
notes.station_summation_order: Per section, chord edges are summed in ascending-parameter order over 64 equal parametric steps across the section's declared knot range; per-section chords are accumulated in section order into a running total; each running total is pushed as that section's station; every station is then divided by the final total (the last station is therefore exactly 1.0).
notes.loft_epsilon: LoftOutput::epsilon equals BandedFactor::max_control_error after loft_sections re-solves the widest control column last, so the delivered L2 width is the GLOBAL maximum control enclosure width of the net.
notes.stop_conditions: No stop condition triggered: landed nurbs types provided all arithmetic needed (no truck-geometry edits), and the union knot vectors evaluated cleanly (no QUESTION.md filed).
